items.title: Exactness of the skyscraper sheaf functor p_* and the functorial splitting p^{-1}p_*A = A \oplus I(A)

items.difficulty_reason: The proof does two things: (2) constructs the functorial direct sum decomposition from the adjunction between p^{-1} and p_* recorded in Sites, taking I(A) to be the kernel of the counit p^{-1}p_*A \to A; (1) assembles exactness of p_* from left exactness (proved earlier in this chapter via the exactness of the pushforward-pullback pair) and preservation of surjections (a Sites lemma). The splitting-with-kernel construction and the two-fact assembly of exactness are the substance; each ingredient is spelled out in the proof lines.
